checks.detail: Visible applicable Area/Screen Min and Max stay enabled in automatic mode and regardless of slider/link state; only true inapplicability or current settings busy state disables them.
Min and Max own separate validation results and aria-invalid values; simultaneous failures are retained independently.
Only each invalid input receives the existing 2px danger border; pair wrapper, settings row and group error borders are forbidden.
Exactly one message is visible: Min first, otherwise Max after Min is valid. Both invalid endpoints may remain red while only Min copy is shown.
Number, finite, domain, order and unit reasons have concise boundary-specific Russian copy.
Raw backend/provider/internal exceptions are not accepted as range field messages; publication errors retain the existing sanitized non-field projection.
Blank auto endpoints, selected-unit projection, double-thumb sliders, double-click reset and serialized autosave are unchanged.
One UI-only presenter integrates into public/js/settings.js and one exact CSS fragment appends to public/css/app.css; shell, settings geometry, API and backend remain untouched.
